## Load packages, source `utils.R`, and outbreak data sets

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(sf)
library(metR)
library(googlesheets4)
library(conflicted)
library(MASS)
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
source("utils.R") # utility functions
save_plot <- FALSE
save_table <- FALSE
# figure size
fgw1 <- figure_size[figure_size$journal =="Lancet",]$single
fgw2 <- figure_size[figure_size$journal =="Lancet",]$double
set1 <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9,"Set1") # color sets
library(patchwork)
# remove the space between the plot and the legend and the space around the plot
# representative probability values for quantile 
probs <- c(0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975)
VW <- 9 # representative vaccination week
VW_seq <- seq(1, 15, 2)
VC <- 0.75 # representative vaccination coverage rate
VC3 <- c(0.6, 0.75, 0.9) # three representative vaccination coverage rates
YEAR <- as.Date("2020-12-28") # the most recent date in which the OCV campaign data is available. This value is from the `max(docv$start_date,na.rm=T)` from the `vacc_impact.qmd` file

theme_set(theme_gray(base_size=14))

shp <- st_read("data/shapefiles/total_shp_0427.shp")
africa <- st_read("data/shapefiles/afr_g2014_2013_0.shp")
```

## Outbreak data and delay

```{r}
outbreak_data_all <- as.data.frame(fread("outputs/outbreak_data_all_20241121.csv"))
outbreak_data <- fread("outputs/outbreak_data_20241121.csv") # for vaccine impact modeling

# fwrite(ocv_use, paste0("outputs/ocv_use_GTFCC_data_", tstamp(), ".csv"))
ocv_use <- fread("outputs/ocv_use_GTFCC_data_20241120.csv")
delay_req_r1 <- as.integer(ocv_use$DATE_ROUND_ONE - ocv_use$DATE_REQUEST)
# max_pop_camp <- max(ocv_use$DOSE_DELIVERED_ROUND_ONE*1000, na.rm=T)
min_pop_camp <- min(ocv_use$DOSE_DELIVERED_ROUND_ONE*1000, na.rm=T)
ocv_delay <- quantile(delay_req_r1, probs=c(0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9), na.rm=TRUE)

# OCV use data
docv <- clean_names(fread("data/outbreak_files_Oct2024/ocv_long_dataset.csv"))
# consumer price index for cost adjustment (2015 to 2023)
dis_params <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread("data/parameters.csv"))
# IVE posterior predictive values from Bayesian beta regression (see parameters.qmd)
ive_fit <- read_rds("outputs/ive_yrep_20241010.rds")
ive_data <- ive_fit$yrep
rm(ive_fit) # large file size

# extract ids for the outbreaks not affected by OCV campaigns
ds <- clean_names(as.data.frame(fread("data/outbreak_files_Oct2024/outbreak_summary.csv")))
paste0(length(unique(ds$country)), " countries")
# create 'id_outbreak' variables to link with the 
ds |>
  group_by(location, outbreak_number) |>
  mutate(id_outbreak = paste0(location, "-", start_date, "-", end_date)) |> 
  ungroup() -> ds

outbk_data_summary <- left_join(filter(outbreak_data, week == 1), ds, by="id_outbreak")
summary(outbk_data_summary$ar_per_10e3)
summary(outbk_data_summary$outbreak_pop)
```

## Burden of cholera outbreaks
Downloaded from Global Cholera and Acute Watery Diarrhoea (AWD) Dashboard (https://who-global-cholera-and-awd-dashboard-1-who.hub.arcgis.com/pages/data-download)
```{r}
c2023 <- fread("data/cholera_adm0_public_2023.csv")
c2024 <- fread("data/cholera_adm0_public_2024.csv")
c2023$year <- 2023
c2024$year <- 2024
chol <- rbind(c2023, c2024)

c2023 |> 
  group_by(year, who_region) |>
  summarize(case_region_total = sum(case_total), 
            death_region_total = sum(death_total)) |> 
  mutate(case_pct = 100 * case_region_total/sum(case_region_total),
         death_pct = 100 * death_region_total/sum(death_region_total),
         case_tot = sum(case_region_total),
         death_tot = sum(death_region_total))

c2024 |> 
  group_by(year, who_region) |>
  summarize(case_region_total = sum(case_total), 
            death_region_total = sum(death_total)) |> 
  mutate(case_pct = 100 * case_region_total/sum(case_region_total),
         death_pct = 100 * death_region_total/sum(death_region_total),
         case_tot = sum(case_region_total),
         death_tot = sum(death_region_total))

chol |> 
  group_by(who_region) |>
  summarize(case_region_total = sum(case_total), 
            death_region_total = sum(death_total)) |> 
  mutate(case_pct = 100 * case_region_total/sum(case_region_total),
         death_pct = 100 * death_region_total/sum(death_region_total),
         case_tot = sum(case_region_total),
         death_tot = sum(death_region_total))
```

## Figure S1. Indirect vaccine efficacy across vaccine coverage

Incidence rate based on the study by Ali (2005) Matlab, Bangladesh
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Individuals targeted for the trial, 89 596
# this is the first year of 4,035 in surveillance and therefore
# vaccine waning is ignored
vc_cutoff <- c(0, 0.28, 0.35, 0.40, 0.50, 0.65) # vaccine coverage cutoff, Table 1
vc_mid <- vc_cutoff[1:5] + diff(vc_cutoff)/2 # mid-point used a coverage
ir <- c(7.01, 5.87, 4.72, 4.65, 1.47) # incidence rate
# baseline incidence rate (i.e., incidence rate at zero vaccination rate)
dat <- data.frame(ir = ir, vc = vc_mid, region = "Matlab")
```

Longini et al. (2007) study provides IVE from their individual-based model.
```{r}
ive_longini <- 
  data.frame(vc = seq(0.1,0.9,by=0.2),
             ive = c(0.3,0.7,0.89,0.97,0.99),
             lb = c(-0.39,0.31,0.72,0.91,0.98),
             ub = c(0.83,0.93,0.98,0.99,1))
```

```{r}
ir_baseline <- 11.2 # Longini et al.(2007) PLoS Med (Fig. 3A)
dat$ive <- 1 - dat$ir / ir_baseline
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
fit <- read_rds("outputs/fit_ive_matlab_20241008.rds")
yrep <- as.data.frame(rstan::extract(fit)$yrep)
pr <- c(0.025, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.975) 
pred <- as.data.frame(t(apply(yrep, 2, quantile, probs=pr, na.rm=T)))
pred$x <- expit(rstan::extract(fit)$new_X[1,,2])

ggplot(ive_longini)+
  geom_point(aes(vc, ive, color="Dynamic model"), shape=15) +
  geom_linerange(aes(vc, ymin=lb, ymax=ub, color="Dynamic model"))+
  geom_point(data=dat, aes(vc, ive, color="Data"), shape=17)+
  geom_linerange(data=pred, aes(x, ymin=`5%`, ymax=`95%`, color="Beta regression"), linewidth=0.4)+
  geom_linerange(data=pred, aes(x, ymin=`25%`, ymax=`75%`, color="Beta regression"), linewidth=0.8)+
  geom_point(data=pred, aes(x, `50%`, color="Beta regression"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1))+
  scale_color_manual("", values=c("Dynamic model"="firebrick",
                                  "Data"="steelblue",
                                  "Beta regression"="black"))+  
  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Vaccine coverage", y="Indirect vaccine effectiveness", color="")+
  theme(legend.position="top") 
```

## Figure S3. Comparison of weekly incidence between the dynamic model and the data
 
```{r}
d <- fread("outputs/incidence_comparison_20241231T15.csv")
d |> group_by(id_outbreak) |> 
  mutate(num_id_outbreak = cur_group_id(),
         week = row_number()) -> d
# plots under "julia/plots/4pfA010" were reviewed and four plots selected
# good: 1, 23
# bad: 3, 40
d <- d |> filter(num_id_outbreak %in% c(1,3,23,40))

ggplot(d)+
  geom_point(aes(week, inc_data))+
  geom_line(aes(week, inc_model), color="firebrick")+
  facet_wrap(~num_id_outbreak, scales="free")+
  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Week", y="Suspected cholera") -> plt

ggsave(paste0("plots/fit_examples_", tstamp(), ".pdf"), plt,
         device = cairo_pdf, width=fgw2, height=fgw2, units="mm")
```

## Figure 2, Outbreak description

### (A) Outbreak time series by group
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# outbreaks that have been excluded
ids_excl <- outbreak_data_all |> 
  filter(!(id_outbreak %in% outbreak_data$id_outbreak)) |>  
  pull(id_outbreak) |>
  unique()

# id's of the outbreaks that were confirmed
ids_conf <- outbreak_data |> 
  group_by(id_outbreak) |> 
  mutate(c_ch_sum = sum(c_ch)) |> 
  filter(c_ch_sum > 0) |> 
  pull(id_outbreak) |>
  unique()

# id's of the outbreaks that were suspected but not confirmed
ids_susp <- outbreak_data |>
  group_by(id_outbreak) |>
  mutate(c_ch_sum = sum(c_ch)) |>
  filter(!(c_ch_sum > 0)) |>
  pull(id_outbreak) |>
  unique()

# id's of the outbreaks that were affected by OCVs
ids_ocv <- outbreak_data_all |> 
  filter(!(id_outbreak %in% docv$id_outbreak)) |>  
  pull(id_outbreak) |>
  unique()

ggplot()+
  geom_line(data=filter(outbreak_data_all, id_outbreak %in% ids_excl),
            aes(date, s_ch, group=id_outbreak, color="Excluded"), 
            alpha=0.5)+
  geom_line(data=filter(outbreak_data, !(id_outbreak %in% ids_conf)),
            aes(date, s_ch, group=id_outbreak, color="Suspected"), 
            alpha=0.5)+
  geom_line(data=filter(outbreak_data, id_outbreak %in% ids_conf), 
            aes(date, s_ch, group=id_outbreak, color="Confirmed"),
            alpha=0.5)+
  scale_color_manual("", values=c("Excluded"="yellow4",
                                  "Suspected"="steelblue4", 
                                  "Confirmed"="firebrick4"))+
  labs(x="", y="Weekly suspected cases")+
  theme_light()+
  theme(legend.position="top") -> plt

plt

if (save_plot) {
  ggsave(paste0("plots/outbk_ts_case_type_", tstamp(), ".pdf"), plt,
         device = cairo_pdf, width=fgw2, height=fgw1*1.1, units="mm")
}

outbk_conf_summary <- outbk_data_summary[id_outbreak %in% ids_conf]
summary(outbk_data_summary$ar_per_10e3)
summary(outbk_data_summary$outbreak_pop)
```


## Figure 3. Percentage case reduction

### Example outbreak time series (no vaccine and vaccine) and vaccine impact

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# week_lst <- read_rds("outputs/svim_week_list_20240822.rds")
# lst <- read_rds("outputs/svim_list_20240822.rds")
week_lst <- read_rds("outputs/svim_week_list_20240813.rds")
lst <- read_rds("outputs/svim_list_20240620.rds")

for (id in unique(week_lst[[runid]]$data_id)) {
  cat("id = ", id, "\n")
  runid <- 1
  outbk_num_id <- id
  vacc_wk <- 4
  
  vacc_cv <- 0.9
  d <- week_lst[[runid]] |> 
    filter(data_id == outbk_num_id, vacc_week == vacc_wk, vacc_cov == vacc_cv)
    
  plot(d$week, d$s_ch, type="l")
  points(d$week, d$s_ch)
  lines(d$week, d$s_ch - d$s_ch_averted, lty="dotted")
  
  readline(prompt="Press [enter] to proceed")
}
# id = 22, 25, 30, 99, 105, 106, 131, 133, 209, 213-4, 259, 285
for (runid in 1:200) {
  cat("run_id = ", runid, "\n")
  d <- week_lst[[runid]] |> 
    filter(data_id == outbk_num_id, vacc_week == vacc_wk, vacc_cov == vacc_cv)
    
  plot(d$week, d$s_ch, type="l")
  points(d$week, d$s_ch)
  lines(d$week, d$s_ch - d$s_ch_averted, lty="dotted")
  
  readline(prompt="Press [enter] to proceed")
}

  filter(data_id == 25, vacc_week == 4, vacc_cov == 0.9)
thr <- ds[ds$ID == 25, ]$threshold
d <- d[, c("date", "s_ch", "s_ch_averted")]
d$s_ch_under_vacc <- d$s_ch - d$s_ch_averted
names(d) <- c("date", "No vacc", "Averted", "Vacc")
# dlong <- pivot_longer(d, cols=c("s_ch","s_ch_under_vacc"))

dar <- data.frame(x=c(1,1), y=c(20,10)) # data for arrow

               arrow=arrow(type="closed", angle=10, length=unit(5,"mm")),
               inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  annotate("text", x=vdate+24, y=144, label= "Vaccine\ntakes effect", hjust=0.8) +
  
  geom_segment(aes(x=vdate-12, y=35, xend=vdate-12, yend=1.8),

  annotate("text", x=as.Date("2010-09-03"), y=6, 
           label= "Vaccination", hjust=1) +

                   y=100,xend=as.Date("2010-08-21"),
                   yend=80), arrow=arrow(type="closed", angle=10, 
                                         length=unit(5,"mm")),

  annotate("text", x=as.Date("2010-10-18"), y=110, 
           label= "Cases reduced \ndue to the vaccine") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=thr - 1, color="firebrick", linetype="dashed")+

  geom_vline(xintercept=as.Date("2010-09-26"), color="steelblue", linetype="dashed")+

  geom_segment(aes(x=min(dlong$date),y=158,xend=max(dlong$date),yend=158),
```

### Impact from preemptive vaccination
```{r}
svim_pe_sum |> 
  filter(vacc_cov %in% VC3) |> 
  group_by(vacc_cov) |> 
  summarize(mean_pct_reduc_case = mean(pct_reduc_case),
            q500_pct_reduc_case = quantile(pct_reduc_case, probs=c(0.5)),
            q025_pct_reduc_case = quantile(pct_reduc_case, probs=c(0.025)),
            q975_pct_reduc_case = quantile(pct_reduc_case, probs=c(0.975)),
            max_pct_reduc_case = max(pct_reduc_case),
            min_pct_reduc_case = min(pct_reduc_case)) -> svim_pe_summary

paste0("maximum percent case reduction from the pre-emptive vaccination are ", 
       format_num(svim_pe_summary$max_pct_reduc_case[1], digits=1), "%, ", 
       format_num(svim_pe_summary$max_pct_reduc_case[2], digits=1), "%, and ",  
       format_num(svim_pe_summary$max_pct_reduc_case[3], digits=1), "% for vaccine coverage rate of  60%, 75%, and 90%, respectively.")
```

### Exponential model fit
```{r}
cts_sel <- c(1,seq(40,280,40)) # case triggers selected

svim_sum_cea |>
  filter(vacc_cov %in% VC, vacc_week <= max(VW_seq)) |>
  group_by(vacc_week) |>
  summarize(vacc_cov = vacc_cov[1],
          count = n(),
          median_prc = quantile(pct_reduc_case, probs=c(0.5))) -> svim_tt_med

f <- function(t, Asym=0, lrc, y0) {
    Asym + (y0 - Asym) * exp(-exp(lrc) * t)
}

fit <- nls(median_prc ~ f(t=vacc_week, Asym=0, lrc, y0),  
           data = svim_tt_med, start = list(lrc = 0.1, y0=100))
fit
# weekly reduction rate
exp(as.numeric(coef(fit)["lrc"]))
# half-life (weeks)
log(2)/abs(exp(as.numeric(coef(fit)["lrc"])))

svim_tt_med$fitted <- fitted(fit)

# case-triggered
svim_ct_sum_cea |>
  filter(vacc_cov %in% VC, case_trigger <= max(cts_sel)) |>
  group_by(case_trigger) |>
  summarize(vacc_cov = vacc_cov[1],
          count = n(),
          median_prc = quantile(pct_reduc_case, probs=c(0.5))) -> svim_ct_med

# res_ct$t <- res$case_trigger
f <- function(t, Asym=0, lrc, y0) {
    Asym + (y0 - Asym) * exp(-exp(lrc) * t)
}
fit_ct <- nls(median_prc ~ f(t=case_trigger, Asym=0, lrc, y0),
           data = svim_ct_med, start = list(lrc=log(0.01), y0=100))
fit_ct
# reduction rate by unit (week or a single case)
(a <- exp(as.numeric(coef(fit_ct)["lrc"])))
# half-life (weeks)
(b <- log(2)/abs(exp(as.numeric(coef(fit_ct)["lrc"]))))
paste0("Medican case reduction (%) decreases with increasing number of cumulative cases with ", format_num(a*100, digits=1) , "% by one case increase, and decreasing by half every ",  format_num(b, digits=1), " additional cases.")

svim_ct_med$fitted <- fitted(fit_ct)
```

```{r}
# In emergency situations, the median time from the event (i.e.
# first laboratory confirmation of cholera or occurrence of humanitarian emergency) to the receipt of the official OCV request was 26 days (range 12–206 days). 

# 26 days
# request to round 1 Median (IQR)	45 (25, 66)

# delay_lower <- (12+45)/7 
# delay_upper <- (206+45)/7

d1 <- subset_random[(vacc_cov == VC & vacc_week == VW)]
d2 <- subset_attack_rate[(vacc_cov == VC & vacc_week == VW)]
d3 <- subset_cases[(vacc_cov == VC & vacc_week == VW)]
d4 <- subset_duration[(vacc_cov == VC & vacc_week == VW)]

tab1 <- impact_summary(d1)
tab2 <- impact_summary(d2)

tab4 <- impact_summary(d4)
```

## Table S3. Summary statistics of the subsets

```{r}
df <- fread("outputs/svim_outbreak_subsets_20241224.csv")
unique(df$subset_method)

df |> # across outbreaks in a given data subset with subset_id
  filter(vacc_cov == VC & vacc_week == VW) |> 
  group_by(subset_method, subset_id) |> # across outbreak ids
  summarize(sum_pop = sum(population),
            sum_case = sum(s_ch_tot),
            overall_ar = 1000 * sum_case / sum_pop,
            sum_dur = sum(duration_weeks)) |> 
  group_by(subset_method) |> # across subset_id 
  summarize(median_pop = quantile(sum_pop, probs=c(0.5)), 
            median_case = quantile(sum_case, probs=c(0.5)),
            median_ar = quantile(overall_ar, probs=c(0.5)),
            median_dur = quantile(sum_dur, probs=c(0.5)),
            lower_pop = quantile(sum_pop, probs=c(0.025)), 
            lower_case = quantile(sum_case, probs=c(0.025)),
            lower_ar = quantile(overall_ar, probs=c(0.025)),
            lower_dur = quantile(sum_dur, probs=c(0.025)),
            upper_pop = quantile(sum_pop, probs=c(0.975)), 
            upper_case = quantile(sum_case, probs=c(0.975)),
            upper_ar = quantile(overall_ar, probs=c(0.975)),
            upper_dur = quantile(sum_dur, probs=c(0.975))) -> dfs
            
tab <- data.frame(subset=dfs$subset_method,
                  population=rep(NA,4), cases=rep(NA,4), 
                  duration=rep(NA,4), attack_rate=rep(NA,4))
for (i in 1:4) {
  
  tab$population[i] <- format_median_with_95(c(dfs$median_pop[i],
                                          dfs$lower_pop[i],
                                          dfs$upper_pop[i]), digit=0)
  tab$cases[i] <- format_median_with_95(c(dfs$median_case[i],
                                          dfs$lower_case[i],
                                          dfs$upper_case[i]), digit=0)
  tab$duration[i] <- format_median_with_95(c(dfs$median_dur[i],
                                          dfs$lower_dur[i],
                                          dfs$upper_dur[i]), digit=0)
  tab$attack_rate[i] <- format_median_with_95(c(dfs$median_ar[i],
                                          dfs$lower_ar[i],
                                          dfs$upper_ar[i]), digit=2)
}
tab

if (save_csv) {
  fwrite(tab, paste0("outputs/subset_summary_stat_", tstamp(), ".csv"))
}
```

```{r}
# fitting exponential decay
res <- cada_75 <- filter(cada, vacc_cov == VC)

f <- function(t, Asym=0, lrc, y0) {
    Asym + (y0 - Asym) * exp(-exp(lrc) * t)
}

fit <- nls(pct_reduc_case ~ f(t=vacc_week, Asym=0, lrc, y0),  
           data=res, start=list(lrc=-1, y0=0.86))
fit
# weekly reduction rate
a <- exp(as.numeric(coef(fit)["lrc"]))
# half-life (weeks)
b <- log(2)/abs(exp(as.numeric(coef(fit)["lrc"])))

paste0("Percentage case reduction (%) decreases with delay in vaccination with ", format_num(a*100, digits=1) , "% by week of delay in campaign vaccination, and decreasing by half every ", format_num(b, digits=1), " weeks.")
```

## Figure S8. Vaccine effectiveness (VE) for  the static and the dynamic model

### Comparison with the dynamic model

Identify outbreaks (`id_outbreak`) that led to poor fits

1. Parameter values are too close to the bound 
2. The number of data points are fewer than 8, two times the number of parameters to be estimated (i.e., 4)
3. Modeled trajectories didn't capture the dynamics of outbreaks
```{r}
# dynamic model fits
fit <- fread("outputs/fit_4p_fA010_20241203T18.csv")
# fit results
fit_ndata <- fread("outputs/fit_params_ndata_20241206T08.csv")
fit_vis <- read_xlsx("outputs/vacc_fit_params_20241203T2122.xlsx")

get_ids_extreme_est <- function(x, er=0.05) {
  # susceptible pop is too close to 1 or 0
  # R0 is too close to a upper bound 30
  ids <- ifelse(x$s0 < 1*er | x$s0 > 1*(1-er) | x$R0 > 30*(1-er), TRUE, FALSE) 
  x$id_outbreak[ids]
}

get_ids_low_ndata <- function(x, threshold=8) {
  # susceptible pop is too close to 1 or 0
  # R0 is too close to a upper bound 30
  ids <- ifelse(x$ndata < threshold, TRUE, FALSE)
  x$id_outbreak[ids]
}

get_ids_poor_fit <- function(x) {
  # only poor fits, when visually assessed, were marked as 1
  # because of NA's, assessing is.na provides a safer way
  ids <- ifelse(is.na(fit_vis$Good_Fit_Visual), FALSE, TRUE)
  x$id_outbreak[ids]
}

# ids_robust <- unique(c(ids1 %in%, ids2))
ids1 <- get_ids_extreme_est(fit, er=0.05)
ids2 <- get_ids_low_ndata(fit_ndata, threshold=8)
ids3 <- get_ids_poor_fit(fit_vis)

ids_poor_fit <- unique(c(ids1, ids2, ids3))
ids_robust <- setdiff(fit$id_outbreak, ids_poor_fit)
```

###  Direct, indirect, total, and overall VE calculation

```{r}
# static model
# effectiveness computations are based on the definition
# DVE, IVE: parameter values
# TVE = 1 - (1-DVE)(1-IVE)
# OVE = 1 - (vc*(1-DVE)(1-IVE) + (1-vc)*(1-IVE))
setDT(outbreak_data)
pop_by_age_wpp <- as.data.frame(fread("outputs/wpp_pop_by_age_20241022.csv"))
age_dist <- pop_by_age_wpp
# extract outbreak data, can be done by including only the first rwo
od <- outbreak_data[week == 1]
od$prop_u5 <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(od)) {
  od$prop_u5[i] <- 
    age_dist[(age_dist$`ISO3 Alpha-code` == od$country[i] &
                as.character(age_dist$Year) == as.character(od$year[i])), "prop_u5"]
}

params <- as.data.frame(fread("outputs/params_20241017.csv"))
vacc_par <- params[,c("vacc_effect_direct_u5", "vacc_effect_direct_5p", "vacc_effect_indirect_id")]
increment <- 0.02 # increment used in posterior predictive values
# vacc_par$ive <- as.numeric(ive_data[vacc_par$vacc_effect_indirect_id, (round(vc/increment)+1)])

lst <- vector('list', nrow(od))
vacc_eff_static <- data.frame()
vcs <- c(0.6, 0.75, 0.9)
nsample <- 200
for (vc in vcs) {
  for (i in 1:nrow(od)) {
    d <- od[i, ]
    d <- rbindlist(lapply(1:100, function(x) rbind(d,d)))
    d$runid <- NA
    d$vacc_cov <- vc
    d$ve_u5 <- NA
    d$ve_5p <- NA
    d$dve <- NA
    d$ive <- NA
    d$tve <- NA
    d$ove <- NA
    
    for (j in 1:nsample) {
      d$runid[j] <- j
      d$ve_u5[j] <- vacc_par$vacc_effect_direct_u5[j]
      d$ve_5p[j] <- vacc_par$vacc_effect_direct_5p[j]
      d$dve[j] <- d$prop_u5[j]*d$ve_u5[j] + (1-d$prop_u5[j])*d$ve_5p[j]
      # d$ive[j] <- vacc_par$ive[j]
      d$ive[j] <- as.numeric(ive_data[vacc_par$vacc_effect_indirect_id[j], (round(vc/increment)+1)])
      d$tve[j] <- 1 - (1-d$dve[j])*(1-d$ive[j])
      d$ove[j] <- 1 - (vc*(1-d$dve[j])*(1-d$ive[j]) + (1-vc)*(1-d$ive[j]))
    }
    lst[[i]] <- d
  }
  vacc_eff_static <- rbindlist(list(vacc_eff_static, rbindlist(lst)))
}

# vacc_eff_static

# dynamic model
# effectiveness computations are based on the modeled incidence 
# d <- fread("julia/outputs/vacc_fit_params_by_vacc_state_20241204T15.csv")
# d <- fread("julia/outputs/vacc_fit_params_by_vacc_state_20241205T15.csv")
# d$dve_vc60_ <- 1 - (d$CI_VC60_vacc/vc)/(d$CI_VC60_novacc/(1-vc))
# d$ive_vc60_ <- 1 - (d$CI_VC60_novacc/(1-vc)) /(d$CI_novacc)
# d$tve_vc60_ <- 1 - (d$CI_VC60_vacc/vc) /(d$CI_novacc)
# d$ove_vc60_ <- 1 - (d$CI_VC60_vacc + d$CI_VC60_novacc)/(d$CI_novacc)

# Vaccine impact simulation results for the dynamic models
d <- fread("outputs/vacc_fit_params_by_vacc_state_20241206T08.csv")
# d <- fread("julia/outputs/vacc_fit_params_by_vacc_state_20241205T17.csv")
vcs <- c(0.6, 0.75, 0.9)

lst <- vector('list', length(vcs))
for (i in 1:length(vcs)) {
  vc <- vcs[i]
  df <- d[, c("runid","data_id","id_outbreak")]
  v <- round(100*vc, digits=0)
  df$vacc_cov <- vc
  df$dve <- 1 - (d[[paste0("CI_VC", v, "_vacc")]]/vc)/(d[[paste0("CI_VC", v, "_novacc")]]/(1-vc))
  df$ive <- 1 - (d[[paste0("CI_VC", v, "_novacc")]]/(1-vc))/d[[paste0("CI_novacc")]]
  df$tve <- 1 - (d[[paste0("CI_VC", v, "_vacc")]]/vc)/d[[paste0("CI_novacc")]]
  df$ove <- 1 - (d[[paste0("CI_VC", v, "_vacc")]] + d[[paste0("CI_VC", v, "_novacc")]])/d[[paste0("CI_novacc")]]
  
  lst[[i]] <- df
}
vacc_eff_dynamic <- rbindlist(lst)

# nrow(vacc_eff_dynamic)/3/200
# [1] 1406
# nrow(vacc_eff_static)/3/200
# [1] 1406
```

## Figure S9 Percentage case reduction for longer outbreaks
### Exponential model fit
```{r}
cts_sel <- c(1,seq(40,280,40)) # case triggers selected
dur_threshold <- 7 # weeks
svim_sum_cea |>
  filter(outbk_dur >= dur_threshold) |> 
  filter(vacc_cov %in% VC, vacc_week <= max(VW_seq)) |>
  group_by(vacc_week) |>
  summarize(vacc_cov = vacc_cov[1],
          count = n(),
          median_prc = quantile(pct_reduc_case, probs=c(0.5))) -> svim_tt_med

f <- function(t, Asym=0, lrc, y0) {
    Asym + (y0 - Asym) * exp(-exp(lrc) * t)
}

fit <- nls(median_prc ~ f(t=vacc_week, Asym=0, lrc, y0),  
           data = svim_tt_med, start = list(lrc = 0.1, y0=100))
fit
# weekly reduction rate
exp(as.numeric(coef(fit)["lrc"]))
# half-life (weeks)
log(2)/abs(exp(as.numeric(coef(fit)["lrc"])))
svim_tt_med$fitted <- fitted(fit)

# case-triggered
svim_ct_sum_cea |>
  filter(outbk_dur >= dur_threshold) |>
  filter(vacc_cov %in% VC, case_trigger <= max(cts_sel)) |>
  group_by(case_trigger) |>
  summarize(vacc_cov = vacc_cov[1],
          count = n(),
          median_prc = quantile(pct_reduc_case, probs=c(0.5))) -> svim_ct_med

# res_ct$t <- res$case_trigger
f <- function(t, Asym=0, lrc, y0) {
    Asym + (y0 - Asym) * exp(-exp(lrc) * t)
}
fit_ct <- nls(median_prc ~ f(t=case_trigger, Asym=0, lrc, y0),
           data = svim_ct_med, start = list(lrc=log(0.01), y0=100))
fit_ct
# reduction rate by unit (week or a single case)
(a <- exp(as.numeric(coef(fit_ct)["lrc"])))
# half-life (weeks)
(b <- log(2)/abs(exp(as.numeric(coef(fit_ct)["lrc"]))))

paste0("Medican case reduction (%) decreases with increasing number of cumulative cases with ", format_num(a*100, digits=1) , "% by one case increase, and decreasing by half every ", format_num(b, digits=1), " additional cases.")

svim_ct_med$fitted <- fitted(fit_ct)
```
